selection_rule: Sort the 53 successful fit demonstrations by collection index; choose positions floor(i*52/19), i=0..19, before observing student outcomes.
notes: Diagnostic only. Existing 20 development results are reused without retry. Fit comparison is conditioned on successful teacher demonstrations, not an unbiased train/dev generalization estimate. Shadow teacher actions are never executed. No optimizer or risk/world-model training. GPU1 only. Development labels must never enter training.
